mcqs.question: For a data set that records the mass of objects in kilograms, which of the following correctly compares the units of variance and standard deviation?

options.A: Variance is expressed in kg², while standard deviation is expressed in kg.
options.B: Both variance and standard deviation are expressed in kg.
options.C: Variance is expressed in kg, while standard deviation is expressed in kg².
options.D: Both variance and standard deviation are expressed in kg².

mcqs.answer: Variance is expressed in kg², while standard deviation is expressed in kg.
mcqs.explanation: Variance is the average of the squared deviations, so its unit is the square of the original unit (kg²). Standard deviation is the positive square root of variance, restoring the original unit (kg). Hence option A is correct; the other options mix up the units.

mcqs.question: Two classes took the same mathematics test. Class X scored: 78, 78, 78, 78. Class Y scored: 60, 78, 90, 102. Both classes have the same average score. Which class shows greater consistency in performance?

options.A: Class X, because its standard deviation is zero.
options.B: Class Y, because its scores are more varied.
options.C: Both classes have the same consistency because they share the same mean.
options.D: Consistency cannot be judged without knowing the median.

mcqs.answer: Class X, because its standard deviation is zero.
mcqs.explanation: Consistency is measured by how tightly data cluster around the mean. Class X has all scores identical, giving a standard deviation of 0, indicating perfect consistency. Class Y’s scores vary widely, giving a larger standard deviation. Therefore option A correctly interprets consistency and spread.

mcqs.question: Which of the following best defines the standard deviation of a data set?

options.A: The positive square root of the variance.
options.B: The average of the deviations from the mean.
options.C: The square of the mean of the data.
options.D: The sum of all deviations from the mean.

mcqs.answer: The positive square root of the variance.
mcqs.explanation: Standard deviation is defined as the non‑negative square root of the variance, which measures the average squared deviation from the mean. Option A states this definition precisely; the other options describe different quantities.

mcqs.question: For the data set {4, 8, 6, 10}, what is the population standard deviation?
mcqs.explanation: Mean = (4+8+6+10)/4 = 7. Squared deviations: (4‑7)²=9, (8‑7)²=1, (6‑7)²=1, (10‑7)²=9. Sum = 20. Variance = 20/4 = 5. Standard deviation = √5. Hence option A is correct; the other options are either the variance or unrelated values.

mcqs.learning_point: Compare data sets using standard deviation
mcqs.question: Data set P has a standard deviation of 3 units, while data set Q has a standard deviation of 7 units. Which statement is true?

options.A: Data set P is less spread out than data set Q.
options.B: Data set Q is less spread out than data set P.
options.C: Both data sets have the same spread because they have the same mean.
options.D: Standard deviation does not provide information about spread.

mcqs.answer: Data set P is less spread out than data set Q.
mcqs.explanation: A smaller standard deviation indicates that the values are clustered closer to the mean, i.e., less spread. Since 3 < 7, data set P is less spread out than Q. Options B, C, and D contradict the definition of standard deviation.

mcqs.question: A chemist measures the concentration of a solution in milligrams per litre (mg/L) over several trials. What will be the unit of the standard deviation of these measurements?
mcqs.explanation: Since the original measurements are in mg/L, the variance is in (mg/L)², and the standard deviation, being the square root of variance, returns to the original unit mg/L. Hence option A is correct; the other options represent incorrect unit transformations.

mcqs.question:
The scores of two batches of students in a physics test are as follows:
Batch A: 85, 86, 84, 85, 86
Batch B: 70, 90, 80, 100, 60
Both batches have the same average score. Which batch demonstrates higher consistency in performance?

options.A: Batch A, because its scores are clustered closely around the mean.
options.B: Batch B, because it includes the highest score of 100.
options.C: Both batches are equally consistent because they share the same mean.
options.D: Consistency cannot be judged without knowing the median.

mcqs.answer: Batch A, because its scores are clustered closely around the mean.
mcqs.explanation: Batch A’s scores vary only by 2 points, giving a small standard deviation, indicating high consistency. Batch B’s scores range from 60 to 100, producing a larger standard deviation and lower consistency. Therefore option A correctly interprets the spread.

mcqs.question: A teacher tells her class: “The standard deviation of the weekly attendance numbers tells us how much the attendance varies from week to week.” Which of the following statements best captures the teacher’s meaning?

options.A: It is the positive square root of the average of the squared differences between each week’s attendance and the mean attendance.
options.B: It is the average of the differences between each week’s attendance and the mean attendance.
options.C: It is the square of the mean attendance.
options.D: It is the total sum of all attendance numbers.

mcqs.answer: It is the positive square root of the average of the squared differences between each week’s attendance and the mean attendance.
mcqs.explanation: The teacher is describing standard deviation, which quantifies variation by taking the square root of the variance (average of squared deviations). Option A states this definition precisely; the other options describe unrelated statistical measures.
